_comment: TIER PROVENANCE BASELINE + CHANGELOG. Why this file exists: commit 67059a8 moved EIGHT nodes shown -> derived-pending inside a commit titled 'R1/R2 complete + format pass' -- zero in-commit rationale, no tier_note change; the move was only reconstructed later by field-level git diff (see dc110ba's certificate and P1A_EDGE_ADJUDICATION_01). test_tier_provenance.py asserts the register's tiers (and node set) exactly match `baseline`; ANY tier change, node addition, or node removal therefore requires editing this file in the same commit -- updating `baseline` AND appending a `changelog` entry with date, authority, and rationale. A tier change without its changelog entry is the 67059a8 defect, and the suite now names it. Entries are APPEND-ONLY (history is never rewritten; git guards the rest). Inception 2026-09-13 at HEAD e76953a; earlier history lives in git and the three seed entries below record what is already reconstructed.
